subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: If an effective mapping or native-profile qualification is found defective after production activation, then the system shall engage FR-27's strongest-profile kill switch, stop new affected claims, invalidate every affected in-flight or unaccepted routing and review-process evidence artifact, and require re-execution or the complete FR-25/FR-26 assurance-pass set on the exact revision before acceptance
intent: exact affected policy/profile versions, attempts, tasks, proposals, assurance passes, and review processes marked `rerun_required`
fit_criterion: a seeded post-cutover qualification defect prevents acceptance of every affected open attempt and proposal until replacement evidence passes; all required assurance passes rerun on the exact head; unaffected routes continue
